designerAbout.name:
IRINA

VERBITSKY
designerAbout.title:
Design starts

with considered

decisions.
designerAbout.description: I’m Irina Verbitsky. I design residential and commercial interiors, considering layout, lighting, materials and details in relation to the purpose of each space and the everyday lives of its occupants.
designerAbout.philosophy: My work draws on salutogenic and biophilic design. These approaches help shape a project around an understandable layout, everyday usability and a connection with nature.

education.title: Master’s degree
education.description: A master’s degree forms my academic foundation. In my work, I combine theoretical training with the analysis of layouts, materials and the ways a space will be used.

salutogenic.title: Salutogenic approach
salutogenic.description: I create spaces that are easy to understand and use, considering layout, lighting and everyday routines. Personal habits and meanings help make an interior not only functional, but also familiar and relevant to you.

biophilic.title: Biophilic approach
biophilic.description: I connect interiors with nature through daylight, plants, natural materials, colours and textures. The aim is not simply to add greenery, but to integrate these elements with the layout and character of the space.
